description: Needs sign-in: Look up which app settings you can read or change, by keyword (e.g. "theme", "angle", "export"). Returns matching setting keys with their allowed values. Only whitelisted settings exist — if nothing matches, the setting cannot be read or changed; say so rather than claiming otherwise. Call this to learn setting keys before get_settings or set_setting.

keyword.description: A keyword to match against setting keys and descriptions.

name: lookup_settings
title: Look up a setting
